name: Raticate

abilities.name: Treasure Collecting
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put all Item cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

flavor:
Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its
balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will
get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

pokedex.text: NO. 0020 Mouse Pokémon HT: 2'4" WT: 40.8 lbs.
